notes: «جميعا عن ابن مهدي» converges the two heads; the names after it are the shared tail.
«- قال زهير حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، -» is Muslim's version note naming a different transmitter for Zuhayr's route: stored as a variant, not a route.
Shurahbil is the one asked and answering («فقلت له فقال»), so he is the last link.
